---
title: "check-exercise-before-result.yml"
---

Diff-scoped, blocking check that flags a result div added or edited
without an exercise and its solution just before it.
Every `#thm-`, `#lem-`, `#cor-` or `#prp-` div gets an exercise
that asks for the result, then the solution,
and the result div states what the solution showed.
The matching citation rule is
[check-solution-citations](check-solution-citations.qmd).
This implements
[gha#1242](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/1242).

## How it reads a chapter

The check flattens each chapter
(a `.qmd` file whose name does not start with an underscore)
into a sequence of blocks, following `{{< include ... >}}` calls into their files.
A block is an include or a top-level `::: {#xxx-...}` div.
Its kind is the prefix of the included file name (`_exr-name.qmd`)
or of the div id.
Blank lines, slide breaks and HTML comments are skipped;
a heading breaks adjacency.
A result block passes when the two blocks before it
are an exercise and then a solution.
With several pairs in a row, only the last pair is read.

## Scope

Only a result whose source file has a line that a diff adds is reported:
the included file for an include, the chapter itself for an inline div.
With no `base-ref`, or when the diff cannot be computed,
the check skips with a warning.
Set `whole-tree: true` to check every result,
which measures how many existing results lack a pair.
`<!-- check-exercise-before-result: allow -->` on the first line of a result
exempts it, for a result that no exercise can precede.
Includes are resolved against the including file's directory
and then the chapter's directory,
so an include written from a different root
(such as a submodule's path) is not followed.

## Usage

Copy
[`examples/check-exercise-before-result.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/check-exercise-before-result.yml)
to `.github/workflows/` in your repository.

## Inputs

| Input | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `globs` | `*.qmd` | Space-separated git pathspecs of tracked files to check |
| `paths-ignore` | empty | Comma- or newline-separated glob patterns to skip |
| `fail` | `true` | Fail the workflow on a finding instead of warning |
| `whole-tree` | `false` | Check every result, not only changed ones |
| `runs-on` | `ubuntu-latest` | Runner label; self-hosted only for a private repository |
| `python-version` | `3.x` | Python version to set up |

## Permissions

The job needs `contents: read` only.
